Pick a sample series and the methods here. Each series is a continuous measurement over time, such as an electrocardiogram or the metrics of a web service.
Dòng này cho biết chuỗi là dữ liệu gì, c: This line says what the series is, how many true anomalous intervals it has, and the question to answer.
Số lớn là số đoạn bất thường bắt được tr: The large number is the anomalous intervals detected out of the total. Each square is one interval: green = detected, red = missed. Click a square to zoom to it.
Đường xám là dữ liệu. Nền cam là bất thư: The grey line is the data. The orange background is a true anomaly. The coloured bars below show when the model raises alarms; overlapping the orange means a correct detection.
Mô hình chấm điểm cho từng thời điểm. Đi: The model scores every time point. A score above the dashed line (threshold) raises an alarm.
